rationale: Claude's plan is the safest spine because its two verified defects fail loudly or merely widen the file map (the false 'repoRoot already imported' claim for test/cli.test.ts, which typecheck catches at once, and the backticked test/support/ that leaks approved paths), while the gap codex and cursor share -- an AGENTS.md edit with no staging route under skip-worktree -- fails silently green since git add -A omits the path and exits 0; on revision the cacheinfo step should become a GIT_INDEX_FILE temp-index write so this clone's index flags are never touched at all, and codex's enumerated path set plus its base-branch-exemption discipline should be folded in.
